upstream.verified: Built here from that commit by artifacts/recipes/speex/, in the wasi-sdk 33 image its stage in the root Dockerfile pins by digest. Driven by our worklet, it puts out, sample for sample, what the build it replaced did (dist/speex.wasm of @sapphi-red/speex-preprocess-wasm 0.4.0 with its worklet) for every input within full scale: seven of the eight voice fixtures.
